name: Chiodos
label: Equal Vision Records
lede: Six Michigan kids named their band after the guys who made Killer Klowns from Outer Space, sold 39,000 records in a week, fired their singer, hired him back, and ended up fighting over who gets to play the old songs.

eras.title: The Chiodos Bros of Davison
eras.text: A high school band from Davison, Michigan, named itself after the special-effects brothers behind Killer Klowns from Outer Space and grew up on the stage of Flint's all-ages Local 432. Three self-made EPs later, Equal Vision Records came calling.

years.h: The Chiodos Bros form in Davison, Michigan
years.p: [[Craig Owens|2e25954c-2b81-43fe-9f83-eeadff769fd3]], Bradley Bell, Pat McManaman, Jason Hale, Matt Goddard and Derrick Frost start a band in high school and play Flint Local 432, an all-ages club downtown.
years.xp:
The name honored Stephen, Charles and Edward Chiodo, the effects trio who made Killer Klowns from Outer Space, as Spin explained in 2011.

They were The Chiodos Bros through three EPs between 2001 and 2003, then shortened it to Chiodos.

years.h: The Chiodos Bros record their first demo
years.p: In June 2002 the band cuts its first demo. EPs follow through 2003, and the name gets shortened to Chiodos.

years.h: Equal Vision signs Chiodos
years.p: After years of touring and self-released EPs, Chiodos sign to Equal Vision Records, also home to [[Coheed and Cambria|ae1b47d5-5128-431c-9d30-e08fd90e0767]] and, soon, [[Circa Survive|a2496a3c-8f42-4b98-b780-6f8d64f56441]].

eras.title: Songs named after movie jokes
eras.text: Chiodos wrote seven-minute post-hardcore songs with titles that read like inside jokes, and a generation of Warped Tour kids learned every one. By 2007 an indie-label band was debuting in the Billboard top five.

years.src: Wikipedia: All's Well That Ends Well
years.h: All's Well That Ends Well, Chiodos' debut
years.p: Recorded in February 2005 at Audiolux in Elmore, Ohio, with producer Marc Hudson. It reaches No. 3 on Top Heatseekers and sells more than 200,000 copies by 2008.
years.xp:
The titles did half the work: There's No Penguins in Alaska, No Hardcore Dancing in the Living Room, Who's Sandie Jenkins. Wikipedia says To Trixie and Reptile, Thanks for Everything is about ex-girlfriends of Craig Owens and Bradley Bell.

Four videos came from the album, including The Words "Best Friend" Become Redefined.
play: Baby, You Wouldn't Last a Minute on the Creek

years.h: Chiodos on Warped, then Atreyu's World Championship Tour
years.p: A year of support slots: Armor for Sleep's AP tour, the Take Action tour with [[Matchbook Romance|71bd1152-5ee2-4919-80d7-d269dfd48a55]], Warped Tour, and [[Atreyu|17e137fb-59e5-4fd7-af48-afc34995396c]]'s World Championship Tour in the fall.

years.h: Craig Owens sings as "the Ram" in The Sound of Animals Fighting
years.p: Owens joins [[The Sound of Animals Fighting|9f492774-4cdb-4735-b299-5b6affafe4d4]], the masked, rotating supergroup, under the name the Ram.

years.h: Bone Palace Ballet debuts at No. 5 on the Billboard 200
years.p: Chiodos' second album sells more than 39,000 copies in its first week and tops the Independent Albums chart. It passes 200,000 in the US by January 2009.
years.xp:
Produced by Casey Bates at Saint Claire Recording Company in Lexington, Kentucky. The title comes from a Charles Bukowski poetry collection; song titles nod to Slaughterhouse-Five, Harry Potter, Wayne's World and Trailer Park Boys.

The singles were Lexington (Joey Pea-Pot with a Monkey Face) and The Undertaker's Thirst for Revenge Is Unquenchable (The Final Battle).

eras.title: Arenas, then the axe
eras.text: Chiodos went from Linkin Park's arena tour to Australia with Nine Inch Nails. Behind it, relations with Craig Owens were souring, and in September 2009 the band cut him loose.

years.h: Chiodos tour with Linkin Park and Coheed and Cambria
years.p: An indie band from Davison opens arenas for [[Linkin Park|f59c5520-5f46-4d2c-b2c4-822eabf53419]], with Coheed and Cambria also on the bill.

years.h: Craig Owens and Bradley Bell start Cinematic Sunrise
years.p: Owens and Bell make a lighter side project, Cinematic Sunrise, away from Chiodos.

years.h: Bone Palace Ballet: Grand Coda with Trailer Park Boys footage
years.p: The reissue adds five bonus tracks and a DVD that includes the Trailer Park Boys cast at a Chiodos show at Madison Square Garden.

years.h: Chiodos tour Australia with Nine Inch Nails
years.p: Chiodos share Australian bills with [[Nine Inch Nails|b7ffd2af-418f-4be2-bdd1-22f8b48613da]] and [[Alice in Chains|4bd95eea-b9f6-4d70-a36c-cfea77431553]]. In March they cover Harvey Danger's Flagpole Sitta for Punk Goes Pop Volume 2.

years.h: Chiodos play the Warped Tour main stage
years.p: On the 2009 Warped Tour main stage with [[The Devil Wears Prada|43c0958c-27ef-46c4-b4cc-83cfca54170d]], [[Bad Religion|149e6720-4e4a-41a4-afca-6d29083fc091]], [[Silverstein|d89de379-665d-425c-b2e9-41b95d1edb36]], [[Saosin|47b8b42a-96e8-46fa-9ea6-70c5136ae971]] and [[Underoath|674a7e8c-9682-419a-8e05-2358e28b5359]]. It is Craig Owens' last summer with the band.

q: This decision was a necessary one.
years.h: Chiodos fire Craig Owens; Derrick Frost leaves too
years.p: On September 24, 2009 Chiodos announce they have let Craig Owens go, refusing to say why. Drummer Derrick Frost leaves at the same time.
years.xp:
The band's statement said the decision was necessary, that they would not discuss the reasons out of respect for their years together, and that they wished Owens well and would carry on.

Wikipedia describes tension and acrimony between Owens and the others before the split. A demo called Thermacare, recorded with Owens that month, leaked in June 2010; his new band D.R.U.G.S. released its own version as The Only Thing You Talk About.

eras.title: The Bolmer detour
eras.text: Chiodos kept going with a new singer and drummer and made one album with them. Two and a half years later, both newcomers were gone and the original singer and drummer were back.

years.h: Brandon Bolmer is Chiodos' new singer
years.p: Alternative Press reports that Brandon Bolmer of Yesterdays Rising will front Chiodos. Tanner Wayne of Underminded takes over the drums.

years.h: Illuminaudio, the only Chiodos album with Brandon Bolmer
years.p: Produced by Machine in Weehawken and Hoboken, New Jersey. Debuts at No. 37; [[Vic Fuentes|b6c39311-3af7-40f9-bd57-69b089c7720d]] of [[Pierce the Veil|8ed919fb-eaee-45a1-ba99-b3ede9ca5f1d]] guests on Love Is a Cat from Hell.
years.xp: By March 2014 it had sold 49,000 copies in the US. It was also Jason Hale's last album with the band. The Owens-era demo Thermacare was reworked here as Stratovolcano Mouth.
play: Love Is a Cat from Hell

years.h: Brandon Bolmer and Tanner Wayne leave Chiodos
years.p: Both newcomers announce their departure on March 27, 2012, after one album and two years.

years.h: Craig Owens returns; first show back at Flint Local 432
years.p: Owens and Derrick Frost rejoin, announced by video on April 26, 2012. The first show back is August 9, 2012 at Flint Local 432, the club where Chiodos started.

eras.title: Devil, and done
eras.text: The reunited band added The Fall of Troy's Thomas Erak and made Devil, a top-15 album. Then the original members started peeling off, and by 2016 Owens said it was over.

years.h: Thomas Erak of The Fall of Troy replaces Jason Hale
years.p: Original guitarist Jason Hale is gone, and Chiodos welcome [[Thomas Erak|ee06d27b-a6e8-47be-aa65-071952cc38e4]] of [[The Fall of Troy|8d3ee4ba-be21-470c-bb7c-4c124c3eb989]] in January 2013.

years.h: Devil debuts at No. 12 on Razor & Tie
years.p: Made in Woodstock, New York with [[David Bottrill|1f2f08f6-487d-4bcc-8f9b-41c170b2464f]]. It sells more than 18,000 copies its first week. Owens said the title is about everyday temptations, not the supernatural.

years.h: Derrick Frost and Matt Goddard leave; Thomas Pridgen joins
years.p: Derrick Frost and founding bassist Matt Goddard leave Chiodos. [[Thomas Pridgen|80a494e5-a517-4f1e-a914-b0638232edf1]], formerly of [[The Mars Volta|20883363-1ea4-4d72-ad72-c0e767038f3e]], takes the drums and Joseph Troy the bass.

years.h: Thomas Erak leaves Chiodos
years.p: Thomas Erak's two-year run ends in December 2014.

q: It just stopped becoming a passion for most of us
years.h: Craig Owens tells Billboard that Chiodos are done
years.p: Owens says the band couldn't keep going full-time and stopped being a passion for most of them.
years.xp: Billboard's Gary Graff got the news in an interview about Owens' new solo project, badXchannels.

eras.title: Chiodos without the Chiodos Bros
eras.text: Craig Owens brought the name back with musicians from D.R.U.G.S. and Frail Body, and without the people he started it with. Bradley Bell said the rest of the original band were never told.

years.h: Chiodos announced for When We Were Young; old members not told
years.p: Chiodos are billed for When We Were Young 2024 in Las Vegas. Bradley Bell says the other original members were never informed of Craig Owens' reunion plans.

years.cap: When We Were Young, Las Vegas, 2024
years.h: Chiodos return at When We Were Young in Las Vegas
years.p: Chiodos' first show in years is October 19, 2024, with Owens the only original member. Weeks later they announce an All's Well That Ends Well 20th anniversary tour with [[Hawthorne Heights|194eeda1-e662-43bc-b9be-32fc1afecc8b]] and Emmure.

years.h: Chiodos sail on the Emo's Not Dead cruise
years.p: The reformed band plays the Emo's Not Dead cruise, then Warped Tour dates and Louder Than Life.

years.h: Bradley Bell calls out the All's Well re-recording
years.p: SharpTone releases a re-recorded 20th anniversary All's Well That Ends Well. Bell says it lacks five of the six original members and tells fans to play the original.
years.xp: On Facebook, Bell wrote that the songs had been written in bedrooms, basements and short buses and meant a lot to the band, and that the original deserved to be preserved, per Lambgoat.

years.h: Tapdat, Chiodos' first new music since 2014
years.p: Chiodos sign to SharpTone and release Tapdat. Their It's Not You, It's Me tour starts July 30, and a new album is due to be recorded after it.

years.h: Chiodos play Louder Than Life with Circa Survive
years.p: Chiodos are on the Louder Than Life 2026 bill in Louisville, the same festival [[Circa Survive|a2496a3c-8f42-4b98-b780-6f8d64f56441]] chose for their comeback.

sources.title: Lambgoat: All's Well re-record called out for excluding original lineup
Noise11: Chiodos return with first new music in more than a decade
